ttps.justification: Technique applies because: authentication bypass. The Valid Accounts technique is relevant because this vulnerability's attack mechanism aligns with Defense Evasion / Persistence / Privilege Escalation / Initial Access phase behavior (analyst inference from advisory text).
ttps.observed_behavior: NOT OBSERVED. Hypothesis from the vulnerability description: exploiting 'U.S. CISA adds SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilit' could enable Valid Accounts (T1078) in the Defense Evasion / Persistence / Privilege Escalation / Initial Access phase. ttps.detection_hint: Alert on authentication from unusual IPs or geographies. Monitor for impossible travel scenarios. Alert on successful auth after multiple failures.
ttps.kql_example: SigninLogs | where ResultType == 0 | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | summarize count() by UserPrincipalName, IPAddress | where count_ > 5

items.kql_query:
// SENTINEL APEX — CVE-2026-121952 — Anomalous Activity Detection
// Product: Web Application | Generated: 2026-11-07T11:46:55Z
let lookback = 1d;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where EventID in (4625, 4648, 4728, 4740, 4776)
| summarize FailureCount = count(), DistinctTargets = dcount(TargetUserName)
    by IpAddress, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where FailureCount > 10 or DistinctTargets > 5
| extend Severity = "MEDIUM", CVE = "CVE-2026-121952", RuleSource = "SENTINEL-APEX"
| order by TimeGenerated desc
